content_sections.heading: Manipur Agriculture Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice's vacancy table shows 69* posts for each of the two posts. Its footnote says that out of the total 69 posts in BTM/ATM, one-third (23) will be reserved for women as per scheme guidelines. The number of posts may increase or decrease. The same category break-up is printed for both posts. OBC is divided into OBC (M) and OBC (MP); PWD is a horizontal reservation. For each post, UR 36, OBC 11, SC 1 and ST 21 add up to 69. Women: one-third (23) of the posts are reserved for women as per scheme guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Manipur Agriculture Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Computer skills are part of the minimum qualification for Block Technology Manager (BTM) only. The notice does not mention any experience requirement for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Manipur Agriculture Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisting for interview on the basis of the Academic Performance Indicator (API) score, in the ratio of 3:1 to the number of posts. Interview. There will be no written examination. The API score calculator is provided on the Department website.

Submit the online form by 26 November 2026. The API score calculator is also on the Department website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Manipur Agriculture Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The vacancy table shows 69 posts against both Block Technology Manager (BTM) and Assistant Technology Manager (ATM), and one-third (23) of the total 69 posts in BTM/ATM are reserved for women.

faq.question: Q2. When does the Manipur Agriculture BTM and ATM online application start?
faq.answer: The online form will be issued on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of the online form is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The processing fee is Rs 800 for UR candidates and Rs. 500 for ST/SC/OBC candidates; PwD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit shall be as per State Government Rules / Policy.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for BTM and ATM?
faq.answer: BTM needs a Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied sector with computer skills, and ATM needs a Graduate in Agriculture/Allied Sector.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of BTM and ATM?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 30,000 per month for Block Technology Manager and Rs. 25000 per month for Assistant Technology Manager.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written exam for Manipur Agriculture Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there will be no written examination; candidates are called for interview in the ratio 3:1 based on their API score, with 70 marks for the API score and 30 for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on a contractual basis under the Centrally Sponsored Scheme "Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension (ATMA Scheme)".

faq.question: Q10. Where can I calculate my API score?
faq.answer: The API score calculator is provided on the official website of the Department of Agriculture, Government of Manipur.
